terms.gloss: be broke, be unable to pay
evidence: Cic. Att. 13.10.3: solvendō nōn erat (Lewis & Short s.v. solvō)
terms.comment: A dative of the gerund: “not to be up to paying”.

sources: Lewis & Short: solvo
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 94.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
